title: Open redirect through a request-controlled typolink target
root_cause: A typolink parameter is filled from GP: without validation. The resulting link can point at an external site or a javascript: URI. Escaping does not mitigate this, because the value is used as a navigation target rather than as text.

origin.reference: OWASP Unvalidated Redirects and Forwards; TYPO3 TypoScript Reference: typolink
